title: Insert Delete GetRandom O(1) - Duplicates allowed
description: Design a data structure that supports insert, remove, and getRandom with duplicates, all in O(1) average time complexity.
pseudocode:
1. map = {val: Set(indices)}
2. list = []
3. insert(val): list.push(val), map[val].add(list.length - 1)
4. remove(val): idx = map[val].values().next(), lastVal = list.pop(), swap(idx, lastVal), update map

steps.note: Insert 1 again: list becomes [1, 1], map becomes {1: {0, 1}}
Remove 1: swap index 0 with last element 2. list becomes [2, 1], map becomes {1: {1}, 2: {0}}
